title: Tour the Workflows screen
blurb: Where your automations live, and the three ways to start one.

steps.title: Open Automation
steps.body: Workflows send your texts, emails and reminders for you. Click **Automation** in the left menu.

steps.title: Describe it to AI
steps.body: Type the job in plain words in **What do you want to automate?** For example: text every new enquiry within a minute. AI drafts a workflow you can check before it goes live.

target.text: What do you want to automate?

steps.lookFor: What do you want to automate?

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.body: **View All Templates** opens ready-made recipes for bookings, follow-ups and reviews. Pick the closest one and adjust it.

steps.title: Build your own
steps.body: **Create Workflow** gives you a blank workflow, or a template to start from.

steps.title: Your workflows and folders
steps.body: Your workflows are listed below with their status. Use **Create Folder** to group them, for example Sales, Bookings and Reviews.

steps.title: What to do first
steps.body: Next: try **Reply to new leads instantly** from the Guide. It is the one workflow every business should have.
